mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (below 2.5%) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO declines.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals reduced residential investment and weaker consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST declines over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in year-over-year CPI inflation above 3.5% signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal a severe labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of instances over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in the federal funds rate above 3.0% signals aggressive policy action that raises borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS exceeds 3.0% over any 3-year rolling window.
